lanes.use_for: cross-lane planning, ADR decisions, long-horizon work

raise_model_to.when: the work is a design as much as an implementation: a decision record, or a state machine on which review rounds keep finding the same family of defect
raise_model_to.how: after a raise in effort, not instead of one; chosen when the session starts, never inside one; kept occasional, so the orchestrator lane's model is used about as much as the other models overall

lanes.use_for: checkable sub-tasks and high-volume runtime work; Batch API when unattended

claude_code.alias_pins: none: each alias resolves as the vendor ships it; a lane's model is what its alias resolved to on read_at
claude_code.why_fable_by_id: the picker's own Fable row was a server-provided claude-fable-5-1[1m]; an allowlist entry for the orchestrator lane's ID hides it, and the picker row names that ID
claude_code.update_channel: latest (ADR 0065), set by name: with no key the settings reference says latest and the setup page the channel chosen at install time

advisor.routine_set_in: home/.claude/settings.json advisorModel, which every Claude Code session on the machine reads
advisor.final_landing_for: a Claude lane started to land a change on scripts/land's TRADING_PATHS; the coordinator writes it to the .claude/settings.local.json at that worktree's own root, never the main checkout's, before the lane starts, and removes it once the lane has landed or stopped (.claude/rules/dispatch-practices.md rule 8)
advisor.pairing: an Opus main model takes an Opus or Fable advisor; a Fable main model takes only Fable, so a Fable lead outside a landing runs with none (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/advisor.md)

runtimes.model_rule: the most capable model Codex offers, at an effort of at least high (the owner's standing instruction, 2026-11-12; ADR 0059 rule 4)
runtimes.service_tier_rule: standard by default; fast for a dispatch a lane, a fix round or a firing waits on, stated by service_tier = "fast" in that worker's workspace .codex/config.toml (ADR 0005)
runtimes.checked_by: scripts/bootstrap --check, rows codex defaults and codex service tier (MISMATCH or NOT SET fails the check); scripts/lanes --rates flags a conversation on another model (OFF-MODEL)

runtimes.label: Gemini 4 Carbon (High)
runtimes.effort: high (in the model slug; the highest agy models lists for it)

runtimes.set_in: launch flags --model and --reasoning-effort (Orca: --model, --effort); the settings key is not documented
runtimes.checked_by: the model and effort the session shows
runtimes.status: deferred by the owner, 2026-11-13: no Muse reviewer is started; the row and its launch flags are kept for a resume (ADR 0045, ADR 0059)

runtimes.set_in: the dsh-tui bundle (agent-default-model row; dsh-tui row effort), unchanged

claude-haiku-5-5.note: prices are 'from'; above 100K-token prompts it is $0.50/$2.50 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing)

landscape_snapshot.caveat: Cost is USD per benchmark task, not per token. Every row was re-checked against the page by a second reader on 2026-11-09. The index version label comes from the site's methodology pages.

not_adopted.why: for the current-generation pairs measured the gain was at the edge of noise or negative at about twice the cost; a weak executor can gain a lot, but no lane here is one

not_adopted.what: second model provider for runtime workers
not_adopted.why: no eval on our own tasks yet; adds a second SDK, cache namespace and failure modes

aliases_valid_on: Anthropic API; other providers resolve the aliases to older models
